XCSH_CSD_DEPLOYMENT_MODE.description: Exclusive resource ownership mode: api or terraform. Choose one ownership mode. Never run the API create/update/delete workflow against resources present in Terraform state.

XCSH_LB_NAME.description: Single unsuffixed HTTPS auto-certificate load balancer name used by either ownership mode

XCSH_ORIGIN_KIND.description: Selects exactly one origin representation: public_name uses XCSH_ORIGIN_HOSTNAME; public_ip uses XCSH_ORIGIN_IP

XCSH_ORIGIN_HOSTNAME.description: Origin DNS hostname used only when XCSH_ORIGIN_KIND is public_name

XCSH_ORIGIN_IP.description: Origin server IP used only when XCSH_ORIGIN_KIND is public_ip

XCSH_APPLICATION_MARKER.description: Required application/scenario content marker, independent of origin representation. Non-reference API and Azure scenarios must set a stable, deployment-specific value.

XCSH_ORIGIN_PORT.description: Origin server port; must be an integer from 1 through 65535

XCSH_HC_NAME.description: Optional healthcheck name; leave empty to omit the healthcheck
